race.comment: AGADOO (9) was a deserving maiden winner by a nose at the Gold Coast nearly 6 weeks ago and has since joined her trainer in a move to Tasmania. She has a good draw and has the scope to make an immediate impact. Follow the market. THISISMYTURF (8) was a rare winner here by a short head at his penultimate start and then battled over 1600m when finishing third in a 5-horse field on this track 2 weeks ago. Stick with him over the more suitable trip of 1400m. KAKIA (1) is racing consistently this prep, and though he has been up a long time, he can run another honest race at this level, especially with the aid of a 4kg claim. HOLD THE DOOR (5) won his maiden at Goulburn in late April and then failed in his next couple of starts before having a spell. He makes his local debut with a couple of trials under his belt, and any market moves will be worth following. CHICANE (2) will find this easier than his last start fourth here a week ago, so keep him safe in all top 4 combos.
